findings.title: Gaza meningitis cases surge as collapsing infrastructure fuels health fears
findings.affected_population_system: Pediatric meningitis admissions declined from over ten daily to three or four, according to pediatrician Sharif Matar; the outbreak continues. He reports that needed meningitis treatments have remained obtainable through Ministry of Health warehouses.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: At one stage, we were receiving more than 10 cases a day. Now we are talking about three to four cases daily.
findings.source_type: Established news outlet, direct attributed interview with hospital pediatrician

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct Al Jazeera Palestine index and full article; compared against 16 authenticated same-day prior heartbeats (07:44–22:44).
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Facility-specific direction of admissions and treatment availability at Rantisi, distinct from prior Nasser capacity/transfer reporting and previously reported territory-wide outbreak totals.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Exact publication hour and interview date unknown; newly discovered during this window, not proof of first publication within it. Single clinician report, not independently verified; do not extrapolate to Gaza-wide trends or conclude epidemic ended.
